_why: The 2026-08-14 faction-economy pass. Income per lord spans 25x across cultures because
fief count and lord count were set independently: Dol Guldur fields 127 lords on 23 fiefs,
Umbar 10 lords on 40. Per-settlement wealth is already uniform across the map, so the gap
is not poor settlements, and new settlements are not available either (the rglConcurrentQueue
prefab cap measured 130,151 of 131,072 with ~921 spare). Raising the existing fiefs of the
eight starved cultures to a shared floor is what is left, and it closes about half the gap.
The four worst (dolguldur, gundabad, goblin, mistymountainorcs) stay below the band even at
vanilla's absolute maxima; their remaining fix is roster size, not fief wealth.
_applied_to: LIVE <game>/Modules/TAOM_Map/ModuleData/settlements.xml, which is unversioned. A module reinstall reverts it silently, which is why validate_moduledata.py gates on this file.
